summary: Find the unique pattern hidden among colorful matching shapes!
description:
Can you find the unique pattern?

Every pattern has a match.
Except one.

Find the unique pattern hidden among colorful shapes, match the duplicates, and reveal beautiful new compositions.

The Unic is a colorful visual observation puzzle about pattern matching, attention and speed. Easy to learn, satisfying to play, and increasingly challenging to master.

HOW TO PLAY

Look carefully at the board and find the pattern that doesn't have a match.

Spot the matching patterns. Capture them. Reveal The Unic.

The mechanic is simple to learn, but patterns can be surprisingly difficult to spot when they're hidden among similar colors, shapes and textures.

DISCOVER HUNDREDS OF PATTERNS

• Hundreds of colorful patterns
• A different puzzle every time
• Geometric shapes, colors and textures
• Pattern collections to complete
• Shards to collect
• Build your own deck
• Daily objectives and rewards

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Choose the experience that suits you:

Chrono — test your observation skills against the clock.
Zen — slow down, relax and solve without the pressure of a timer.
Crazy Flip — turn the challenge upside down.

A VISUAL PUZZLE FOR PATTERN LOVERS

Love geometric designs, colors, textures and visual puzzles?
The Unic turns pattern recognition into a simple, endlessly replayable challenge.

No internet connection required.
The Unic is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available.

Finalist — International Mobile Game Awards 2020
